<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Visual</title><style>html,body{margin:0;background:transparent}iframe{display:block;border:0;width:100%;height:100vh}</style></head><body><iframe src="/visual-frame.html" sandbox="allow-scripts" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" title="Visual"></iframe><script>(() => {
  const frame = document.querySelector("iframe");
  let visual = null;
  const send = () => {
    if (visual) frame.contentWindow.postMessage({ type: "rufi-visual", html: visual.html, theme: visual.theme }, "*");
  };
  frame.addEventListener("load", send);
  window.rufiCard = {
    show(html, theme) {
      visual = { html, theme };
      send();
    },
    theme(theme) {
      if (!visual) return;
      visual.theme = theme;
      frame.contentWindow.postMessage({ type: "rufi-visual-theme", theme }, "*");
    },
  };
  addEventListener("message", (event) => {
    const data = event.data;
    if (event.source !== frame.contentWindow || !data) return;
    if (data.type === "rufi-visual-height" || data.type === "rufi-visual-broken") {
      window.webkit?.messageHandlers?.card?.postMessage({ type: data.type, height: Number(data.height) || 0 });
    } else if (data.type === "rufi-visual-send" && typeof data.text === "string") {
      window.webkit?.messageHandlers?.card?.postMessage({ type: data.type, text: data.text });
    }
  });
})();</script></body></html>

<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Visual</title></head><body><script>(() => {
  const parent = window.parent;
  if (parent === window) return;
  const card = "(() => {
  const parent = window.parent;
  const style = document.createElement("style");
  document.head.append(style);
  const BASE = "html{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-ui);line-height:1.5;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}body{margin:0;display:flow-root}button[data-rufi-send]{font:inherit;font-size:0.8125rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;min-height:36px;padding:0 14px;margin:4px 8px 0 0;cursor:pointer}button[data-rufi-send]:hover{background:var(--page)}button[data-rufi-send]:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}@media (pointer:coarse){button[data-rufi-send]{min-height:44px}}";
  const paint = (t) => {
    if (!t || typeof t !== "object") return;
    let css = ":root{color-scheme:" + (t.scheme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light") + ";";
    if (typeof t.fontSize === "string") css += "font-size:" + t.fontSize.replace(/[;{}<>]/g, "") + ";";
    const variables = t.variables && typeof t.variables === "object" ? t.variables : {};
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(variables)) {
      if (/^--[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(name)) css += name + ":" + String(value).replace(/[;{}<>]/g, "") + ";";
    }
    style.textContent = css + "}" + BASE;
  };
  try { paint(JSON.parse(document.getElementById("rufi-theme").textContent)); } catch {}
  addEventListener("message", (event) => {
    if (event.source === parent && event.data && event.data.type === "rufi-visual-theme") paint(event.data.theme);
  });
  let height = -1;
  const measure = () => {
    if (!document.body) return;
    const now = Math.ceil(document.body.getBoundingClientRect().height);
    if (now === height) return;
    height = now;
    parent.postMessage({ type: "rufi-visual-height", height: now }, "*");
  };
  let broken = false;
  const broke = () => {
    if (broken) return;
    broken = true;
    parent.postMessage({ type: "rufi-visual-broken" }, "*");
  };
  // A button's message (ADR 0035): on a person's click or key, its words
  // go to the screen, which sends them as their message. A double click's
  // second click sends nothing more.
  document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    if (event.detail > 1 || !(event.target instanceof Element)) return;
    const button = event.target.closest("button[data-rufi-send]");
    const text = button ? button.getAttribute("data-rufi-send").trim() : "";
    if (text !== "") parent.postMessage({ type: "rufi-visual-send", text }, "*");
  });
  document.addEventListener("securitypolicyviolation", broke);
  addEventListener("error", broke, true);
  // The root's size follows the body's; it is there from the start.
  new ResizeObserver(measure).observe(document.documentElement);
  addEventListener("load", measure);
})();";
  const take = (event) => {
    const data = event.data;
    if (event.source !== parent || !data || data.type !== "rufi-visual" || typeof data.html !== "string") return;
    removeEventListener("message", take);
    const inert = document.createElement("template");
    inert.innerHTML = data.html;
    for (const element of inert.content.querySelectorAll("link, meta, base, script, iframe, frame, object, embed, area")) element.remove();
    for (const link of inert.content.querySelectorAll("a")) link.replaceWith(...link.childNodes);
    const theme = JSON.stringify(data.theme ?? null).replace(/</g, "\u003c");
    document.open();
    document.write('<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><script type="application/json" id="rufi-theme">' + theme + '</' + 'script><script>' + card + '</' + 'script></head><body></body></html>');
    document.close();
    document.body.append(inert.content);
  };
  addEventListener("message", take);
})();</script></body></html>
